clock.label: CET
clock.meaning: Trip times are minutes after 00:00 of their date on this shared clock; countryOffsets give the minutes to add for each country's local time on each date.

footpathsMeaning: Reviewed walking links between two stations (config/rail-reviewed-footpaths.json), in footpaths.json as [from, to, minutes] by station row. A walk is taken only straight after a train or from the origin, never two in a row, and counts as the change.
meaning: The timed trains of this delivery for the route finder; see rail_data/route_finder.py.

notices.replacementBusesMeaning: Replacement buses of this week. The search does not route them: only those in replacementBusesWithTimes publish individual times in this delivery. Results touching these stations say a replacement bus exists there.
notices.scope: Primary scheduled rail with published clock times, each train counted once (the duplicate rule of assets/rail-duplicates.json). Changes only within one canonical station, over a reviewed stay-on-board link, or over a reviewed footpath. Platforms are not published.
notices.sourcesWithoutTimesMeaning: Published sources with no timed train in the search: their clock times are not published here (see the clock notices), so journeys over them are not found.

stayOnBoardMeaning: Reviewed through-services: a passenger stays on board from the first trip onto the second at the station on the listed dates. Built only from the reviewed composed journeys of files.throughContinuations (continuation.callSources), never inferred; native parts are identified by journey id and run id, never by train number. Rows: [fromSource, fromJourneyId, fromRunId, fromLabel, toSource, toJourneyId, toRunId, toLabel, canonicalStationId, dates, dayOffset, reviewId]. Resolved to dated trips in links.bin; the summary counts rows, composed journeys and handoffs that could not be resolved, by reason.
